rejection_reason: [cohort_study] The article reports MRI volumetric analysis in Rett syndrome patients and controls but does not provide specific genetic variant data (no HGVS or mutation/amino acid/nucleotide changes are listed). It describes MeCP2 mutation confirmation for diagnosis, but without variant details. The study design is a cross-sectional comparative analysis between RTT patients and controls, i.e., a cohort-like study.
